sentence.trust: {thread}'s session wants to work in this folder. Claude will be able to read, change and run files in it, and in folders inside it.
sentence.mcp_consent: {thread}'s session wants to turn on this server's tools for its folder.
sentence.login: {thread}'s session needs you to sign in to Claude on the Mac.
sentence.dev_channels: Main session's start needs this to talk to the Talos app.

devChannels.alsoLoads: Also loads {channels}, which Talos didn't add.
devChannels.launchChanged: Main's start command changed since you last confirmed it.
devChannels.launchUnconfirmed: Main's start command isn't confirmed on this Mac yet.

footer.card: Your Mac presses the key for you. The session answers your message once it is in.
footer.popup: Also on your phone. Answer either one.
footer.popupMain: Your phone is told to come here.

phone.devChannelsWaiting: Main is waiting at your Mac: answer the Talos popup there.
